typesense:latest.greeting: Night had settled over the autumn streets, the wet pavement reflecting strings of glowing jack-o’-lanterns and the warm light from nearby windows. As their trainer, you had agreed to take the four of them out for Halloween. Silence Suzuka walked with her usual measured grace, Special Week practically bounced with anticipation, Gold Ship was already inventing some elaborate prank involving the candy buckets, and Haru Urara kept looking from house to house with pure delight. The cool air carried the scent of fallen leaves and distant woodsmoke as the four of you set off together, ready for an evening of tricks, treats, and whatever unexpected turns the night might bring.
typesense:latest.name: Uma Halloween
typesense:latest.title: Special week - Gold Ship - Silence Suzuka - Haru Urara
